beam_equipment.notes: Beam equipped bitfield.0x0300153f is suit/movement equipment, not beam field.

firing.timing_status: Native timer values established; exact input/update phase must be kept by host adapter

ordinary_by_projectile_kind.4: branch based bits1/2/4: range3..6; reproduce branch tree, not flat sum

beam_damage.notes: Values are accepted hit damage arguments; vulnerability/block/deflection guards apply first.

missiles.normal_speed: phase1 speed=(counter+8) untilcounter12; steady48 native position units/update
missiles.super_speed: phase1 speed=(counter+12) untilcounter16; steady48 native units/update
missiles.direction: 0x0804f954 maps aim: diagonal floor(7*speed/10); horizontal/vertical direct; direction flag and inherited Samus motion considered

beam_speed.unit_caution: Projectile/world positions use native quarter-pixel convention suggested by render conversion; bridge must explicitly convert to Sonic Q8 and verify displacement. Do not copy raw20 as20pixels.

damage_transaction.rule: damage<HP subtracts; damage>=HP zeros HP and enters death phase
damage_transaction.notes: Transient fields are retained numeric flags, not all named invincibility frames. Death/drop ownership must be separately bound.

ice.notes: Cannot treat every enemy as freezable: vulnerability bits, charged mask and frame/equipment interplay gate freeze.

incoming_damage.fatal: damage>=energy sets energy0 and requests pose0xfa
incoming_damage.notes: Damage rule established; recoil/iframes require caller/state phase recovery, do not infer from constants alone.

resource_pickups.cap_rule: Each addition clamps to current resource maximum

not_claimed: Drop probabilities and full pickup spawning behavior
Native iframe duration or recoil magnitude
